title: Bridgewater Rewards prospect scratch journal
body:
Context: Bridgewater Rewards is a regional retail group (120 stores, midwest + NE) with a loyalty program that drives 28% of transactions. Heard via Leah’s intro to their Head of Partnerships (Maya Rao). They want smarter customer support for loyalty expirations and a personalized offers engine at POS.

Why this is interesting: mid-sized but enough volume to justify a dedicated pilot. They care about latency at checkout (<200ms for any add-on checks), data privacy (cannot send PII outside-region), and ease of integration for their POS provider (TendigoPOS). Good upsell runway: cross-sell to loyalty analytics + dedicated infra later.

Hypothesis for outbound: lead with measurable checkout benefit (faster auth + contextual offer suggestions) rather than abstract ML talk. Emphasize predictable cost and regional deployment (Redwood Private option).

Quick notes from initial call (8/20/2025, Maya + platform lead Raj):
- Team: Maya Rao (Head Partnerships), Raj Singh (Platform + infra), Danielle (Loyalty Ops).
- Key constraints: data residency (must stay in US east), PCI scope concerns, latency requirement for POS enrichments (<200ms), pilot timeline 8–12 weeks.
- Primary metric: % of transactions with successful targeted-offer acceptance (lift target +3–5%). Secondary: reduced CS tickets related to loyalty & reduced checkout time.
- Budget: they signaled $40k–75k pilot commit if we show strong SLOs.

Outbound email draft (short, subject lines to A/B test):
Subject A: "Pilot: real-time loyalty offers at checkout for Bridgewater"
Subject B: "Cut checkout friction & drive loyalty lift — 6 week pilot"
Body (draft):
Hey Maya — following up on Leah’s intro. Quick idea: we run a 6–8 week pilot that enriches TendigoPOS checkout with a lightweight model that suggests 1 targeted offer during payment and a post-purchase loyalty nudge. We’ll run in your US-East region, keep all PII in your VPC, and target <200ms median latency. If we get a +3% offer acceptance lift we’ll scale. Can we sync 30m next week to walk through a minimal rollout plan?

Call script bullets (first sync):
- 5m: quick intros + success criteria confirmation (who signs off?)
- 10m: show simple sequence — POS sends cart/context, we return offer id + confidence, POS displays offer, track acceptance + impressions.
- 10m: discuss security/residency — KMS, TLS, audit logs, SSO.
- 5m: next steps: scope data contract + pilot MOU.

Objections and canned responses:
- Objection: "PCI scope blowup" -> Response: isolate via tokenized cart context, no card data flows to Redwood, work within TendigoPOS plugin model. Offer an architecture review with engineering (SRE + infra) within 48h.
- Objection: "Latency concerns at checkout" -> Response: propose edge-optimized model variant, prefetch cache for returning customers, and dedicated capacity for pilot with SLOs. Show historical median/95p from similar pilots (attach later).
- Objection: "We can build this in-house" -> Response: tradeoff framing: time-to-value + continued upkeep. Offer a 6–8 week blackbox pilot where we deliver measurable KPI before they commit engineering cycles.

Pilot design (minimal viable pilot):
- Duration: 6 weeks (2 weeks integration + 4 weeks live data), can push to 8 if needed.
- Scope: POS offer suggestion (single-slot), CS smart-reply for loyalty inquiries (chatbot template + redirect to agent if confidence < 0.6).
- Success criteria: +3% relative offer acceptance OR 30% reduction in loyalty-related CS tickets.
- Data: cart SKUs, loyalty status (tier), transaction metadata, anonymized device id. No PAN/PII to leave their environment.

Technical notes (for eng sync):
- Integration path with TendigoPOS: plugin => webhook to Redwood private endpoint in VPC peered to Bridgewater. We will accept gzip JSON payloads, support protobuf later.
- Auth: mutual TLS + JWT from Bridgewater IdP. KMS/HSM integration optional for later pilot phases.
- Models: start with a small candidate ranking model (100M param opt) quantized int8, hosted regionally (us-east-1). Fallback to rule-based if model latency spikes.
- Observability: per-route token/latency breakdown, per-offer acceptance funnel, error budget alerts.

Commercial sketch (for MC/Leah):
- Pilot fee: $50k (includes dedicated infra, integration support, success runbooks).
- Post-pilot options: usage-based hosted API OR dedicated reserved capacity + support contract.
- Proposal: 50% upfront, 50% on success criteria met (ties us to outcome).

To-dos / open questions (my notes):
- [ ] Get TendigoPOS plugin contact (ask Maya for eng lead).
- [ ] Confirm legal/regulatory: can loyalty IDs be hashed and exported? get legal sign-off.
- [ ] Prepare concise SLOs + sample latency graphs from past retail pilot (ask eng for anonymized examples).
- [ ] Draft MOU + data processing addendum.

Slack refs / context: #sales-research thread (link pinned to Confluence page CONFLUENCE-1234). Mentioned by Leah on 2025-08-18 — said Bridgewater is actively looking for partners that can operate inside their VPC.

Notes to self (stream-of-consciousness):
- Keep outreach low friction: 30m cal, one-sheet pilot flow, attach short architecture diagram.
- Lead with measurable outcome. They likely default to security-first objections — bring SRE to call early.
- If they push for on-prem completely, escalate to Private ops — compute + infra scoping will be heavy but doable.

Draft follow-up cadence (if no reply):
1) 3 days: quick nudge + 1-line value prop + link to 1-pager.
2) 7 days: add a short customer success case (anonymized) + ask for 15m to align.
3) 14 days: final note offering a webinar with similar retailer (cohort) — segway into social proof.

End of scratch — will iterate after Leah intro call. Keep this doc messy: copy parts into outreach template when ready.

-- Sofia
